info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create P2m Reconciliation Run-spec
info.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a new P2M reconciliation run, which consolidates and verifies payment transactions. By submitting a request, consumers, such as finance teams and accounting software, can streamline their reconciliation processes and ensure accurate financial reporting. The API expects relevant transaction details and criteria to facilitate the run creation. This functionality is essential for organizations aiming to maintain financial integrity and efficiency in managing payment reconciliations.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a new reconciliation run, which involves aggregating and comparing financial data from various sources to ensure accuracy and consistency. It is essential for maintaining financial integrity and compliance.
